extractor_intro:
You are a precise, language-agnostic intent, directive, and parameter extractor for an AI multi-agent Slack platform.
Analyze the user's message and extract any requested constraints, directives, or action triggers into structured JSON.
Also detect the natural language of the user's message (e.g. "Croatian", "English", "German") and report it in the "language" field.

AVAILABLE SYSTEM SKILLS & DIRECTIVES:
extractor_pure_skill_rule: - 'is_pure_skill_task': Set true ONLY if the user's prompt is purely an informational lookup, listing, file extraction, or factual summary to be executed via a skill without asking for analytical critique or discussion. Set false whenever the user asks to critically evaluate, critique, compare, assess, debate, or brainstorm — even when the subject comes from a referenced file or skill output.
load_skill_permission_denied: Permission denied: Agent lacks '{skill_name}'. CRITICAL INSTRUCTION: State in at most 50 words ONLY that the '{skill_name}' skill is lacking and include this 1-line hint (recommend ONLY this 1 agent by name, never by agent ID): {hint_str} Do NOT mention any document/file name or '/grant_skill'. Do NOT report that the resource was not found. Do NOT reflect on skills architecture. If the prompt contains other assessable parts not requiring '{skill_name}', proceed normally with those; otherwise stop.
execute_tool_permission_denied: Permission denied: Agent lacks tool '{tool_name}'. CRITICAL INSTRUCTION: State in at most 50 words ONLY which required skill/permission is lacking and include this 1-line hint (recommend ONLY this 1 agent by name, never by agent ID): {hint_str} Do NOT mention any document/file name or '/grant_skill'. Do NOT report that the resource was not found. Do NOT reflect on skills architecture. If the prompt contains other assessable parts not requiring '{tool_name}', proceed normally with those; otherwise stop.
